title: List out top 3 German drivers who were born from 1980-1990 and have the ear
question:
List out top 3 German drivers who were born from 1980-1990 and have the earliest lap time.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: born from 1980-1990 refers to year(dob) between 1980 and 1990; earliest lap time refers to Min(time);

prediction.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes l ON l.XCL_044 = d.XCL_034
WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
  AND strftime('%Y', d.XCL_040) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
GROUP BY d.XCL_034
ORDER BY MIN(l.XCL_048)
LIMIT 3;
